title: 跨境电商
html:
跨境电商

概述

本章聚焦跨境电商场景，分为跨境核心词汇、支付与汇率、国际物流、合规与法规四个部分。它帮助读者掌握跨境业务特有的术语，尤其是支付、物流和合规这些与国内电商差异最大的环节。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，便于业务沟通和文档处理。建议把核心词汇与合规、物流术语结合学习，理解跨境场景下的实际约束。

跨境核心词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
cross-border adj. 跨境的 cross-border trade, cross-border payment
customs n. 海关 customs clearance, customs duty
tariff n. 关税 import tariff, tariff rate
compliance n. 合规 regulatory compliance, compliance requirements
localization n. 本地化 market localization, localization strategy
marketplace n. 市场平台 online marketplace, global marketplace

听说例句

A: Are we ready for customs clearance in the EU market? B: Almost. We need to finalize the compliance requirements and confirm the tariff classification for our products.

A: How is the localization going for the Japanese marketplace? B: The product listings are translated, and we're adapting the payment flow for local preferences.

写作表达

  • Cross-border trade requires strict adherence to customs regulations and tariff classification standards.
  • A comprehensive localization strategy is essential for successfully entering new international marketplaces.

支付与汇率

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
exchange rate n. 汇率 current exchange rate, fluctuating exchange rate
currency n. 货币 local currency, multi-currency support
settlement n. 结算 payment settlement, settlement period
remittance n. 汇款 overseas remittance, remittance fee
escrow n. 第三方担保 escrow service, payment in escrow
chargeback n. 拒付 chargeback rate, prevent chargebacks

听说例句

A: Do we support multi-currency checkout? B: Yes, we convert to local currency at checkout using real-time exchange rates. Settlement happens weekly.

A: Our chargeback rate is increasing in the US market. B: We need to review our fraud detection system and tighten the escrow release criteria.

写作表达

  • Multi-currency support with real-time exchange rate conversion is critical for a seamless cross-border shopping experience.
  • The average settlement period has been reduced from 14 days to 5 days through process optimization.

国际物流

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
freight n. 货运 air freight, freight cost
customs broker n. 报关行 hire a customs broker, licensed broker
bonded warehouse n. 保税仓 bonded warehouse storage, bonded zone
last-mile delivery n. 最后一公里配送 last-mile logistics, last-mile challenge
transit time n. 运输时间 average transit time, reduce transit time
duty-free adj. 免税的 duty-free threshold, duty-free import

听说例句

A: What's the average transit time from China to the US? B: About 7-10 days by air freight. We're also exploring bonded warehouses to reduce delivery time.

A: Is it cheaper to use a customs broker? B: Yes, a licensed broker handles clearance faster and helps avoid compliance issues.

写作表达

  • Establishing bonded warehouses in key markets significantly reduces transit time and customs processing delays.
  • Last-mile delivery remains the most challenging and costly segment of the international logistics chain.

合规与法规

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
regulation n. 法规 government regulation, comply with regulations
certification n. 认证 product certification, obtain certification
trademark n. 商标 register a trademark, trademark infringement
intellectual property n. 知识产权 protect IP, IP rights
GDPR n. 通用数据保护条例 GDPR compliance, GDPR requirements
VAT n. 增值税 VAT registration, VAT rate

听说例句

A: Do we need VAT registration for the UK market? B: Yes, it's mandatory. We also need to ensure GDPR compliance for handling customer data.

A: Has anyone filed for trademark protection in the new markets? B: We've registered in the US and EU. Southeast Asia is still pending.

写作表达

  • All products sold in the European market must carry the appropriate certification and comply with local regulations.
  • Protecting intellectual property through trademark registration is a fundamental step in any cross-border expansion strategy.
